engine: ANALOG-X Regional Terrain Window Discovery & Robustness Engine

scientific_contract.unit_of_analysis: 5.55 km × 5.55 km regional terrain windows sampled inside ten pre-selected 30 km Earth study/reference areas
scientific_contract.score_interpretation: Exploratory terrain-only proximity index using equal-weight IQR-normalized absolute gaps in median slope, P90 slope and P90 3×3 local relief. It is not a probability, geological match, mission score or landing-suitability assessment.
scientific_contract.scale_limit: Earth inputs are Copernicus DEM GLO-30 DSM resampled to ~925 m; the Moon input is 80 m LOLA aggregated to ~925 m; Mars uses ~925 m MOLA. The 5.55 km windows retain ~925 m spatial support.
scientific_contract.window_overlap: Sliding windows overlap and are spatially dependent. Weight sensitivity is not a statistical confidence interval.
scientific_contract.candidate_limit: Results identify candidate sub-windows within the ten existing study regions only. They are not a whole-Earth scan or newly validated geological analog discoveries.
physical_nontransferability: Earth gravity and atmosphere differ from the Moon and Mars.
Terrain similarity does not measure lithology, mineralogy, regolith strength, dust, water or radiation.
No rover-scale trafficability, landing safety, resource access or base suitability is inferred.
scientific_contract.inspiration_and_method_note: The IQR-normalized terrain-distance and rank-sensitivity ideas were independently implemented after reviewing public NASA Space Apps examples from Team Shoemaker and Earth Analog Explorer. No competitor source code is copied into this engine.
scientific_contract.coordinate_note: Displayed WGS84 window centres are approximate offsets from each parent study-area reference centre using nominal grid spacing. They are map locators, not surveyed coordinates, field-station positions or parcel boundaries.

target.name: Shackleton Rim / lunar south pole
target.source: NASA LRO LOLA PDS GDR LDEM_80S_80M aggregated to ~925 m
target.source_coverage: 32×32 interpolated elevation grid; LDEC reports 99.9949% mean native-pixel return support per coarse cell

scan.valid_window_rule: At least 26/36 valid elevation cells and 15 valid slope and relief samples
scan.stability_definition: Percentage of random Dirichlet(1,1,1) feature-weight draws for which this window ranked in the top decile of its own 30 km parent region. Rank sensitivity only—not analog probability or statistical confidence.
scan.selection_rule: Up to 30 windows, max 4 per parent region, at least 6 km apart
